newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET - MAJOR ORDER WITH BAAN.
newsitem.headline: VALMET - MAJOR ORDER WITH BAAN.

text.p: Finnish paper machinery group Valmet Oy said on Tuesday it had placed a "major" investment with Dutch/American software house the Baan group.
"Valmet has ordered an exceptionally large business and production control system from Baan, a Dutch/American software house," Valmet said in a statement, which gave no value for the order.

"According to Baan, the agreement made with Valmet is its most significant so far in the Nordic countries, and can be compared in size with Baan's agreements with the aviation giant Boeing and with British Aerospace," Valmet said.
Once introduced at Valmet premises around the world, the system would be used by about 6,000 Valmet employees, it said.
